title: Children of Ruin
author: Adrian Tchaikovsky
summary: Long after humanity's first great star voyages, a new expedition follows a trail of old terraforming experiments to a planet where life has taken an unexpected shape. It sets two strange stories running side by side.
readIf: you like science fiction that is curious about alien minds and how intelligence might evolve.
skipIf: you have not read Children of Time, because this builds directly on it.

pairings.reason: Another story of explorers meeting a place that changes how life works, with a creepier mood.
A classic about trying and failing to understand an alien intelligence.
Another big idea story about contact with a species whose logic is not ours.
